dose_response.dose_definition: L1 +-3px id-hash jitter on every node; L2 swap the two lowest sorted ids; L3 reflect the first half of sorted ids about the canvas centre (breaks mirror symmetry); L4 sub-grid offset (+7,+5) on odd nodes (breaks row/column alignment). Cumulative.

causes: DOMINANT — stale-geometry recompute under relocation: the D6 doses move NODE CENTRES but the manual docs' stored route polylines / coordinate anchors do not move (byte-faithful ③A caliber).  The new per-edge features (anchor orientation, straight-rate, detour) recompute against that stale geometry and inject directionless noise: v2 (centre-based features) degrades coherently (11/15 monotone) while v3-alpha does not (4/15)
score saturation: 11/15 anchors already score >= 90 at L0 (in-sample AUC 1.0 -> logistic overconfidence), so small feature changes near the cluster produce outsized swings
L1 jitter (+-3 px id-hash) sits below the 0.1 score resolution: 8/15 L1 steps score 0.0 delta, so the measured dose is effectively L2+ only
L2 swap2 RELOCATES two cards wholesale; for centre-based features (hub_degree / alignment / centroid) a relocation is not a degradation — 10/14 increase steps happen at L2
shape routing flips mid-dose (3 anchors): the score switches weight sets across the routing threshold, a discontinuity the monotonicity read penalizes but the certificate does not
followup_proposals: re-route or geometrically regenerate edge routes/anchors for perturbed docs before extracting edge-aggregate features (needs an engine-side capability — separate card, not this one)
score calibration (isotonic/temperature scaling on a held-out split) to fix top-of-scale saturation
add a route-preserving dose level (style/bend perturbations on the stored polylines themselves) to dose-response
failure_analysis.same_pairs_verdict: v3-alpha REGRESSES on dose-response vs the committed v2 model on identical pairs (4 vs 11 monotone-decreasing of 15 scored)

dose_response.source: perturbation pairs = committed diagnosis card D6 (diagnosis-hub-collapse.json D6_perturbation), generators replicated verbatim; the SAME pairs are re-scored under the committed v2 model as the same-pairs comparison column

families: anchor orientation deviation + edge mirror consistency (strict caliber, slot sub-caliber = g<->g; golden as data)
routing regularity (detour ratio + kink count, per edge)
loop closure quality (arc share + bow agreement/outward share)
style consistency role-conditioned (loop arc rate vs non-loop straight rate)
